lines.text: People plan to go to a city for a year, carry on business, and make a profit.
James says their life is a mist, so they ought to say, "If the Lord is willing."
James calls their boasting wise, and says anyone who knows the right thing but fails to do it is guilty of sin.
James tells the rich to weep, because their riches have rotted, moths have eaten their clothes, and their gold and silver are corroded.
The rich withheld the wages of the workmen who reaped their vineyards, and the cries of the harvesters reached the Lord of Hosts.
